title: Default room policy: give the member and admin roles canReportAbuse
description: Filed on the report-abuse branch as mimid-umnp (that tracker copy was not main's); re-filed here. Since the hub checks room-policy-04 §8.3 canReportAbuse for a reporter (decision mimid-1wgh.57), the default roles must grant it. Done in c6197f5 (branch policy-defaults), test members_and_the_admin_may_report_abuse.
